15. a) Albert Schultz 
c) Representative, Milwaukee School Board
d) 57
e) Stated the Milwaukee School
Board has not taken a
position for or against
construction of freeways. The
school board has adopted a 1973 report\nentitled "A Study of Air Pollution
and Noise Hazards".
f) The report contained recommendations g) for all Milwaukee Schools concerning air and noise pollution and access problems.
Our studies indicate that the air quality in the vicinity of Hamlin-Garland School will not be significantly impacted with construction of the Airport Spur. Corrective abatement measures to reduce noise levels will be done in cooperation with the School Board. Since the freeway will be in embankment and local through streets will be bridged, access to the school will not be interrupted.
